So I am trying to save the file to the www subdirectory.

shinyServer(function(input, output, session)  {

  obs <- observe({   
  logfilename <- paste0('www/vote',input$deelnemer, '.csv') 
  cat(c(input$motion1, input$motion2, input$motion3, input$motion4, input$motion5),"\n", file = logfilename, sep=",")
  })

  session$onSessionEnded(function() {
  obs$suspend()
})
})

This works fine locally. However, if I deploy the app, I quickly get this message:

The application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console

I have no idea how to access the Javascript error console is. So I got stuck here.

Any help for this shiny-newbie is much appreciated.
